function.name: read_document
function.description: Read the current Jx document, or the subtree at a given path. Use this to discover node paths before calling set_property, add_child, or delete_node.

path.description: Path to a node in the document, as a JSON array of keys/indices from the root (e.g. ["children", 0, "children", 1]). Use read_document to discover valid paths. Omit to read the whole document.

function.name: set_property
function.description: Set or remove a property on a node (e.g. tagName, textContent, className, style, attributes, $props). Pass value: null to remove the property.

path.description: Path to a node in the document, as a JSON array of keys/indices from the root (e.g. ["children", 0, "children", 1]). Use read_document to discover valid paths.

key.description: The property name to set, e.g. "textContent" or "className".

value.description: The new value, or null to remove the property.

function.name: add_child
function.description: Insert a new child node into the children array of the node at parentPath, at the given index (0 = first child). The node definition follows the Jx document schema (e.g. { "tagName": "p", "textContent": "Hello" }).

parentPath.description: Path to a node in the document, as a JSON array of keys/indices from the root (e.g. ["children", 0, "children", 1]). Use read_document to discover valid paths. Must point at a node, not a children array.

index.description: Position in the children array to insert at.

node.description: The Jx node definition to insert, e.g. { "tagName": "div", "children": [] }.

function.name: set_style
function.description: Set or remove a CSS style property on a node. Style property names use camelCase (e.g. "backgroundColor", "fontSize", "borderRadius"). Values are always strings (e.g. "10px", "center", "var(--color-accent)"). Pass value: null to remove.

path.description: Path to a node in the document, as a JSON array of keys/indices from the root (e.g. ["children", 0, "children", 1]). Use read_document to discover valid paths.

property.description: CSS property name in camelCase, e.g. "backgroundColor".

value.description: CSS value as a string (e.g. "10px", "var(--color-accent)"), or null to remove.

function.name: set_text
function.description: Set the textContent of a node. Convenience alias for set_property with key: 'textContent'.

path.description: Path to a node in the document, as a JSON array of keys/indices from the root (e.g. ["children", 0, "children", 1]). Use read_document to discover valid paths.

function.name: add_state
function.description: Add a new reactive state variable under the document's `state` object. The value can be a scalar (e.g. 0, ""), a typed object ({ "type": "string", "default": "" }), a computed string ("${state.other}"), a function ({ "$prototype": "Function", "body": "..." }), or a data source ({ "$prototype": "Data", "$src": "./data.json" }).

value.description: Initial value or state shape object (scalar, typed, computed, function, or data source).

function.name: update_state
function.description: Update or remove an existing state variable at the document root. Pass value: null to remove.

key.description: State variable name to update, e.g. "count".

value.description: New value (same shapes as add_state), or null to remove the state variable.

function.name: move_node
function.description: Move a node from one location to another in the document tree. The node is removed from fromPath and inserted into toParentPath at toIndex.

fromPath.description: Path to a node in the document, as a JSON array of keys/indices from the root (e.g. ["children", 0, "children", 1]). Use read_document to discover valid paths. The node to move.

toParentPath.description: Path to a node in the document, as a JSON array of keys/indices from the root (e.g. ["children", 0, "children", 1]). Use read_document to discover valid paths. The target parent (a node, not a children array).

toIndex.description: Insertion index in the target parent's children array.

function.name: create_component
function.description: Create a new Jx component file on disk. Writes the component JSON to the given relative path within the project. The content must be a valid Jx component document.

path.description: File path relative to the project root, e.g. "components/newsletter-form.json".

content.description: The complete Jx component JSON (must include tagName, optionally state, style, children, $elements).

function.name: create_page
function.description: Create a new Jx page file on disk. A page typically includes a layout component and section children. The content must be a valid Jx page document.

path.description: File path relative to the project root, e.g. "pages/about.json".

content.description: The complete Jx page JSON (typically includes $elements to import a layout, children for sections).
